question: List each pair of singers who performed together in at least one concert. Do not include a singer paired with themselves.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s1.Name, s2.Name FROM singer_in_concert AS sc1 JOIN singer_in_concert AS sc2 ON sc1.concert_ID = sc2.concert_ID AND sc1.Singer_ID < sc2.Singer_ID JOIN singer AS s1 ON sc1.Singer_ID = s1.Singer_ID JOIN singer AS s2 ON sc2.Singer_ID = s2.Singer_ID
candidate_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    s1.Name AS singer_1,
    s2.Name AS singer_2
FROM singer_in_concert AS sc1
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sc2
    ON sc1.concert_ID = sc2.concert_ID
JOIN singer AS s1
    ON sc1.Singer_ID = CAST(s1.Singer_ID AS VARCHAR)
JOIN singer AS s2
    ON sc2.Singer_ID = CAST(s2.Singer_ID AS VARCHAR)
WHERE s1.Singer_ID < s2.Singer_ID;
